protocol.formula: ageYears + C(recordedSex) + heartFailure + coronaryHeartDisease + angina + previousHeartAttack + previousStroke + diabetes + currentSmoker + bmi + systolicBloodPressure + creatinine
protocol.selection: Fixed unweighted candidate; normalised examination weights are sensitivity only, not used to select the winner.
protocol.primaryMetric: five-year IPCW Brier error versus both training-fitted baselines
protocol.censoring: Unweighted training Kaplan–Meier censoring distribution; assumes independent censoring.
protocol.lifetime: Weibull mean extrapolation is not validated by five-year error or concordance.
